## Fixed

- **Updates:** Larvyn now finds the newest release. GitHub can list releases out of order, so beta.9 said it was the newest and didn't offer beta.10. Version checks also ignore build metadata (`+…`), as semver says.

If you're on beta.9 or earlier, the update screen may still say you have the newest release. Install this one with:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/larvyn/releases/main/install.sh | sh
```

Everything from [beta.10](https://github.com/larvyn/releases/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.10), including plugins, is in this release.
